name: Future Man
description: Josh Futturman, a janitor by day/world-ranked gamer by night, is tasked with preventing the extinction of humanity after mysterious visitors from the future proclaim him the key to defeating the imminent super-race invasion.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Josh Futturman feels stuck in his dead-end job as a janitor so all he really does is play Biotic Wars, an unbeatable videogame the rest of the world has given up on. But when Josh beats the game, mysterious visitors from the future appear: the world is in danger, and Josh is the only one who can save it.

videos.title: Herpe: Fully Loaded
videos.overview: In 1969, Josh, Tiger, and Wolf launch a mission to infiltrate a fraternity party and prevent Dr. Kronish from contracting herpes—but the destruction they’ve left in their wake quickly catches up with them.

videos.title: A Riphole in Time
videos.overview: Tiger and Wolf decide it’s time for Dr. Kronish to die. Josh reluctantly agrees to help—but when he realizes he can’t go through with it, he finds himself caught in Tiger and Wolf’s sights instead.

videos.title: A Fuel's Errand
videos.overview: In the wake of the disastrous attempt to assassinate Dr. Kronish, Tiger and Wolf kick Josh off the mission. When they realize their Time Travel Device is compromised, Josh makes a deal: if he can get them more fuel, they’ll let him back on the team.

videos.title: Justice Desserts
videos.overview: Tiger, Wolf, and Josh work to unmask the Biotics undercover at the Kronish Labs Christmas party. Meanwhile, Josh grows closer to his coworker Jeri as she helps him avoid the obsessed policeman hot on Josh’s tail.

videos.title: A Blowjob Before Dying
videos.overview: With just twenty-seven minutes before a bomb explodes in the head of their captured Biotic, Josh, Tiger, and Wolf hold a high-stakes interrogation in Josh's bedroom while Josh’s unwitting parents host a holiday dinner party downstairs.

videos.title: Pandora's Mailbox
videos.overview: Josh, Tiger, and Wolf jump into the future to steal the fuel they desperately need to continue their mission. But when they arrive at their destination, they are confronted by an unexpected enemy.

videos.title: Girth, Wind & Fire
videos.overview: The end of the mission is in sight as Tiger and Wolf prepare for one final jump into the past. But when Josh’s mom is kidnapped, Josh refuses to let Tiger and Wolf leave before they mount a daring rescue to save her.

videos.title: Operation: Fatal Attraction
videos.overview: Convinced he knows how to stop Dr. Kronish once and for all, Josh commandeers the TTD and leads the team on a mission into the past. But when Wolf goes missing, they have to spilt up, forcing Josh to carry out his insane plan alone.

videos.title: Operation: Natal Attraction
videos.overview: Still in the past, Josh desperately tries to change Dr. Kronish’s future while not messing up his own. Meanwhile, Tiger and Wolf confront each other over Wolf's wavering dedication to the cause.

videos.title: Beyond the TruffleDome
videos.overview: Torn apart by internal divisions, the team is scattered throughout history, as Tiger and Wolf reckon with the way the mission has changed them and the possibility that they might fail.

videos.title: Prelude to an Apocalypse
videos.overview: Josh discovers that his interference in the past has completely transformed his life…for the better. Wolf and Tiger deal with the aftermath of their failed mission to the past.

videos.title: A Date With Destiny
videos.overview: Out of time and options, the team reconciles that their actions have made everything much, much worse and plan one final mission to put an end to Dr. Kronish and the Cure forever.

videos.title: Countdown to a Prologue
videos.overview: Josh is confused to discover that he’s been released from jail. As he tries to make sense of this, he quickly realizes that all is not as it seems in his world. A new nefarious plan is afoot and Josh is being pulled into it whether he likes it or not.

videos.title: The i of the Tiger
videos.overview: Tiger and Wolf arrive in the future they created. Tiger is not welcome in The NAG (The New Above Ground) so she heads to The Mons where she learns humanity is moving to Mars, her DNA created the cure, and Stu Camillo is alive and well in hologram form.

videos.title: A Wolf in the Torque House
videos.overview: Wolf is mistaken for Torque (the Wolf in this timeline) and he goes with it – learning about the NAG, and its 6-parent families and hatred of technology. Wolf tries to escape but the appeal of this new, strange world makes it hard for him to leave.

videos.title: Guess Who's Coming to Lunch
videos.overview: As Tiger gets to know her doppelganger Ty-Anne, Wolf acclimates to the NAG, and Josh wanders the desert. Josh is brought to the NAG and remanded to indentured servitude as a technology smasher.

videos.title: J1: Judgment Day
videos.overview: Josh, Tiger, and Wolf go on a mission to find their TTD and take down the Pointed Circle.

videos.title: The Binx Ultimatum
videos.overview: Tiger uses Stu’s fondness for her to help her track down Athena. Meanwhile, Josh is now a “Smasher” remanded to a labor camp, where the Pointed Circle comes after him. Wolf, vowing to improve the NAG, faces off against Supreme Overlord Vice.

videos.title: Homicide: Life in the Mons
videos.overview: Wolf, ignoring warnings about the Pointed Circle, brings Josh to live outside his Clusternest. Tiger reaches a dead end in her quest for the TTD.

videos.title: The Last Horchata
videos.overview: Stu introduces a depressed Tiger to his simulation – where anything can be reality, drawing them closer than ever before.

videos.title: The Ballad of PUP-E Q. Barkington
videos.overview: Stu sends commandos to abduct Josh in the NAG – chaos and bloodshed ensue. Josh and Wolf learn the identity of Achilles, the elusive leader of the Pointed Circle.

videos.title: Exes and OS
videos.overview: Ty-Anne shares the story of growing up with Stu as her father and her early exposure to The Pointed Circle. Josh believes he’s the key to stopping Stu once and for all.

videos.title: Dia De Los Robots
videos.overview: It’s the day of the MARS launch. Josh goes on a suicide mission to sneak into Stu’s upload machine to shut him down for good.

videos.title: The Brain Job
videos.overview: Armed with the newly discovered TTD, our team uses an 11-second window to jump back in time over and over to reach Stu’s brain and destroy it.

videos.title: Ultra-Max
videos.overview: Having messed with time travel one too many times, Josh, Tiger, and Wolf land in jail in the year 3491. Facing a death sentence for their crimes, their loyalty to each other is tested by their cruel and unusual jailer, Susan.

videos.title: The Precipice of Yesterday
videos.overview: Josh, Tiger, and Wolf are forced to compete in the Diecathalon, but a complication arises that puts them at odds with each other.

videos.title: There Will Be Borscht
videos.overview: Josh puts his faith in The Voice while Wolf basks in his element and Tiger struggles to adapt.

videos.title: Trapper's Delight
videos.overview: Josh’s crisis of faith comes to a head as Tiger connects with her killer instincts, and Wolf struggles to lay low.

videos.title: The Outlaw Wild Sam Bladden
videos.overview: Tiger and Wolf come to terms with their true selves as Josh is forced to confront what and who he truly believes.

videos.title: Haven Is for Real
videos.overview: Josh makes a risky deal. Tiger and Wolf let Josh take command.

videos.title: The Land After Time
videos.overview: Josh discovers a new happiness as Wolf loses his mind and Tiger embarks on an unexpected journey.

videos.title: Time Rogues III: Escape From Forever
videos.overview: Josh and Wolf reunite and make a desperate move to escape while Tiger reconciles her past and present selves.

videos.title: Return of the Present
videos.overview: The universe is about to end. For real this time.

language: English, Spanish, Russian, Mohawk, French, Japanese, German
